box: Extracts all the text inside a bordered box in your document. Specify a word or phrase that's printed in or near the box, and Sensible finds and reads the box automatically.
checkbox: Reads whether a checkbox is checked or unchecked. Specify a word printed to the left or right of it, and Sensible searches in that direction to find and read the checkbox.
nearestCheckbox: Reads whether a checkbox is checked or unchecked. Specify a word or phrase printed anywhere near the checkbox, and Sensible finds the closest one automatically.
